data.define: To study many things quickly just before a test.

misuse.why: Cramming only works for short tests.

data.l1_hook: ‘cram’, 내일 시험인데 아직 공부를 못 했어!

native.tip: “cram” = 벼락치기하다. 예문: “I must cram for math.”
